purpose: Teach: くれれ/ならば/混入/マッチング/尚/４つ/小銭/おこっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さん、若い頃、すぐに来てくれればと願ったぞ
lines.en: Gran — when Dad was young, I kept wishing he'd come visit more.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. Soft warmth mixed with old longing. Slow, measured delivery. Eyes distant on memory. Slight pause before the wish lands.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、雨ならば、お祖父ちゃんが傘を貸してくださったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and your grandfather would lend me his umbrella when it rained, remember?
lines.style: Warm agreement that blooms into memory. Gentle tilt toward him on the question. Intimate, as if inviting him back into the moment. Soft on the final word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、食品への混入を厳しく見張られたぞ
lines.en: Gran — he watched over Dad so carefully when he was young, especially about what went into the food.
lines.style: Reverent, almost protective tone on the memory. Slight crack of admiration underneath. Slow pace. Respectful weight on how seriously it mattered.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お見合いのマッチングで、私と結ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather and I — we were brought together through a matchmaker, weren't we?
lines.style: Pleased, almost playful confirmation. Slight lilt of delight on the rhetorical question. Warm, as if savoring the beginning of their own story.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、尚、ご親戚もご一緒だったぞ
lines.en: Gran — your relatives came along too, on that meeting.
lines.style: Simple, factual statement delivered with quiet fondness. Steady pace. The detail matters to him — not spectacular, but true.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お子さん、４つ、お持ちでしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And we ended up with four children, didn't we?
lines.style: Satisfied, almost celebratory lilt. Pride in the fact itself. Warm, rhetorical. A moment of quiet counting of blessings.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃんが小銭を貯金箱に入れてらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when Dad was young, your grandfather used to save his coins in a piggy bank.
lines.style: Tender amusement underneath. Small smile in the voice. The memory of a small, careful habit. Affectionate, almost endeared by the detail.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、地震がおこった時のことお話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather told me about the earthquake that day — you remember that story?
lines.style: Soft opening into memory. Gentle inquiry, inviting shared recollection. Tender close, as if checking he hasn't forgotten something precious to both of them.
